# Sonder Project

> Sonder Project is a creative digital agency that builds apps, websites and
> AI integrations for businesses. Its flagship product is Surfdesk
> (https://thesurfdesk.app), the client tracker where nothing falls through
> the cracks.

Website: https://www.sonderproject.co
Try Surfdesk: https://thesurfdesk.app
Contact / book a call: https://cal.com/dante-valentino/ai-consulting

## About

Sonder Project designs and builds the software businesses run on: custom
apps, high-performance websites, and AI woven into everyday workflows. It also
builds and runs its own products, starting with Surfdesk. Every client project
is custom-built, with no templates.

## Flagship Product: Surfdesk

- **Surfdesk** (https://thesurfdesk.app): A client tracker that keeps
  follow-ups from slipping. Say it once ("Marcus got the job, call him
  Friday") and it saves the note, sets the reminder and records the outcome.
  Every client, follow-up and visit in one place, on any phone.
- For agencies and nonprofits: shared caseloads, outcome tracking, and an
  Impact report (people served, outcomes reached, one-click PDF) that builds
  itself for funders.
- For small businesses and solo professionals: every regular, every service,
  every follow-up, and revenue by service.
- Pricing: free for 7 days, then $9/month for individuals or from $19 per
  staff member per month for teams.

## Services

- **Custom apps & digital products**: built and shipped end to end.
- **Sonder Studio** (https://sonderstudio.space): premium web design and
  development, including scroll-driven animation, brand identity and
  conversion-focused design.
- **Sonder Consulting**: AI strategy, workflow automation, AI integration and
  custom AI tools for businesses.

## Who It's For

- Agencies, nonprofits and case-management teams (Surfdesk)
- Small businesses, freelancers and solo professionals (Surfdesk)
- Businesses that want a custom app, a website that converts, or AI working
  in their operations (agency services)
